triples.head_surface: progressive flooding of intact ballast tanks due to damaged ballast pipes
triples.head_canonical_zh: 压载管损坏导致完整压载舱渐进进水
triples.tail_surface: redundancy and certification of ballast pumps, and the provision of suitable remote control
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 压载泵冗余与认证及合适遥控装置
triples.evidence_text: These requirements are intended to provide a reliable means of pumping and draining ballast tanks through redundancy and certification of ballast pumps, and the provision of suitable remote control, where fitted. These requirements also provide a suitable means of preventing both the progressive flooding of intact ballast tanks due to damaged ballast pipes

triples.head_surface: crosscontamination between ballast water and other fluids on board the vessel
triples.head_canonical_zh: 压载水与船上其他流体交叉污染
triples.tail_surface: redundancy and certification of ballast pumps, and the provision of suitable remote control
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 压载泵冗余与认证及合适遥控装置
triples.evidence_text: These requirements are intended to provide a reliable means of pumping and draining ballast tanks through redundancy and certification of ballast pumps, and the provision of suitable remote control, where fitted. These requirements also provide a suitable means of preventing both the progressive flooding of intact ballast tanks due to damaged ballast pipes and also crosscontamination between ballast water and other fluids on board the vessel

triples.head_surface: movement of the valve position due to vibration or flow of fluids
triples.head_canonical_zh: 振动或流体流动引起阀位移动
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 正向保持装置或等效装置
triples.evidence_text: Where butterfly valves are used, they are to be of a type with positive holding arrangements, or equivalent, that will prevent movement of the valve position due to vibration or flow of fluids.
